name: swarm-court
description: Multi-agent QA: specialist sub-agents hunt bugs by lane (functional, race conditions, data integrity, authz/security, database, queue/cache/external, performance, frontend, UI/UX, ops, adversary), skeptics verify every finding, and you get one deduplicated report with test cases and a PASS/WARN/BLOCK release gate. Stdlib-only Python, no API key.
